subject: Quality Observatory: transition plan and monitoring gates for ZenWell integration
messages:
From: Natalie Park <natalie@zenwell-health.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for ZenWell Prod rollout

Thanks Michael — great to meet last week. We're ready to move from pilot to a staged production rollout and want to make sure Redwood's Quality Observatory (prompt sets, eval harness, regression alerts, canaries) is wired up before we ramp traffic.

Ask: can your team confirm the minimal deliverables we need to go from pilot → 10% traffic canary (2 weeks) → 100%? Specifically we need:
- canonical prompt sets for each intent (diagnosis-sum, triage-recommend, patient-summary)
- eval harness integration for nightly scoring + baseline run
- regression alert thresholds and notification recipients
- explicit canary/rollback triggers (what metrics/how long)

Attached: zenwell-kpis.csv (our internal success metrics) and a redacted SOC2 excerpt for your security team. Procurement also asked for a short checklist showing monitoring/gates before they sign final SOW.

Proposed timelines: Kickoff this week, instrument tests by next Tues (21st), canary by Dec 28. Procurement is aiming for signature the week of Jan 4.

Thanks,
Natalie
Head of Integrations, ZenWell Health

--
ZenWell Integrations Team

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for ZenWell Prod rollout

Thanks Natalie — copying the implementation and CS leads so we have clear owners. High-level response and next steps below; I'll drop a concise "QC setup checklist" (PDF) into Drive and link back.

Minimum deliverables from Redwood's side (what we'll provide by Tuesday 2026-12-21):
1) Prompt-set templates (canonical prompts + test cases) for the three intents you called out. We'll hand over a CSV with prompts + expected labels and a short README for editing.
2) Eval harness integration: a nightly job (hosted) that consumes your labeled promptset and returns run-level metrics (pass rate, avg quality score, top-k divergence). We'll provide the harness webhook and a sample payload.
3) Regression alerts: default thresholds that we recommend (configurable): nightly pass-rate drop > 5 percentage points OR avg quality score delta <= -0.08 relative to baseline for 48h. Alerts go to your Slack + our SRE + CS.
4) Canary & rollback policy: recommend 48-hour canary at 10% traffic with step-up at 24h if no alerts. Automatic rollback if any of the following during the canary window:
   - sustained pass-rate drop > 7 points over 12h
   - avg eval score delta <= -0.12 over 6h
   - error rate spike > 2x baseline for 30m
We will also give a manual fail-safe (one-click rollback) in the console.

I'll upload the QC setup checklist (qc-setup-checklist.pdf) and the initial prompt-set CSV by EOD. Proposed times for a 30m sync: Tue 12/15 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 14:00-14:30 PT. What works for you?

—Michael
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

On the canary/rollback policy: agree with Michael's thresholds. Add one note: when we step from 10%→50% we want a manual gate (CS + Eng approval) regardless of metrics to ensure product readiness and documentation.
